source.citation: Lu, X., Lagnoni, M., Bertei, A., et al. Multiscale dynamics of charging and plating in graphite electrodes coupling operando microscopy and phase-field modelling. Nat. Commun. 14, 5127 (2023)

files_used.source_data: data/raw/lu2023/41467_2023_40574_MOESM5_ESM.xlsx (sheets: Fig. 2, Fig. 4, Fig. 5, Fig. 6, Fig. 7, Fig. 8)

source.data_availability_statement: The data generated in this study are available in the main text and Source Data file.

global_conditions.electrode: graphite, areal capacity 2 mAh/cm2, strip 2.2 x 8 mm2, ~50 um coating thickness (stated)
global_conditions.cell: EL-cell ECC-Opto-Std optical cell: glass window / graphite on Cu / 250 um glass-fibre separator / Li foil (stated)
global_conditions.geometry_note: Li+ enters through the lateral surfaces (LSE). The optical 'thickness' is the in-plane 2.2 mm x-direction. Current density = total current / four lateral surface areas (stated)
global_conditions.electrolyte: not stated for the optical cell. Coin cells use 1 M LiPF6 in EC:EMC 3:7 vol + 2 wt% VC (stated, Methods); assumed but not confirmed for the optical cell
global_conditions.temperature: not stated for the optical cell (coin-cell OCV tests at 25.8 C)
global_conditions.c_rate_equivalence: 2 mA/cm2 (lateral) corresponds to 1C in the coin-cell experiments (stated)

quantities.value: charge 2 mA/cm2 -> 3 h relax -> discharge 2 mA/cm2 -> 3 h relax -> same at 4 mA/cm2
quantities.notes: Segment times from Source Data (derived): cycle 1 charge 0-13.90 h, relax 13.90-16.90 h, discharge 16.90-26.20 h (9.29 h), relax 26.20-29.20 h; cycle 2 charge 29.20-36.18 h (6.98 h), relax 3.00 h, discharge 4.72 h, relax 3.00 h; end 46.91 h. See lu2023/lu2023_fig2_segments_derived.json

quantities.quantity: optical-cell voltage vs time (Fig. 2 voltage panel; same curve as the movie inset)

uncertainty.note: raw data; time column continuous across segments

quantities.notes: Converted by scripts/groundtruth/convert_lu2023_source_data.py. The sheet has 8 (time, voltage) column pairs.

source.text: Results: 'the voltage profile becomes negative and reaches a plateau after 10-h charging, indicating the onset of plating, which is also visually confirmed at the LSE at Timestep 4'

quantities.notes: Timestep 4 is the end of charge (labelled 14h in Fig. 2), so the visual confirmation is at ~13.9 h, not at 10 h.

quantities.quantity: voltage markers of plating onset, cycle 1 (2 mA/cm2) charge
quantities.notes: Which marker equals 'onset' is a definition choice. The paper's model uses a 20 mV nucleation barrier (crossed at 8.9 h). The stated '10 h' lies between the -30 mV crossing and the plateau.

value.stated: charged at 4 mA/cm2 for only ~1 h, beyond which large-scale plating occurred (voltage dip then long plateau)

quantities.notes: Not shown in the movie (the movie covers the 2 mA/cm2 cycle only).

quantities.quantity: graphite colour -> particle SOC (x in LixC6)
quantities.unit: x in LixC6 (particle-level SOC as decimal)

uncertainty.note: '~' (approximate); Fig. 1e places the swatches at x ~0.02, 0.24, 0.50, 0.96 on the OCV curve

quantities.notes: Percent SOC in the paper means global electrode SOC; decimal means particle SOC. Surface saturation ~0.98 is the stated prerequisite for plating.

quantities.unit: um (along the x / thickness direction, starting at the LSE)
quantities.notes: Conflicts with the scale bar. Registering the movie to the Fig. 2 strips (50 um bar) gives 3.92 px/um (range 3.83-4.02 over 20 registrations with >=100 inliers), so the 1280-px movie frame spans ~326 um (318-335), not 400 um. The registration scale drifts ~4% between timesteps (0 h vs 14 h), consistent with electrode expansion on lithiation. See movie_calibration.

quantities.quantity: Fig. 2 timestep labels (time within each segment, as printed)
quantities.notes: Qualitative ground truth per timestep (stated): at 4 h three colours coexist (red/blue/gray); at 8 h gold nucleates at the LSE; plated Li visible at the LSE at ts 4 (green arrows); gold region grows slightly during the first 1.5 h of relaxation and then fades; after the 2 mA/cm2 charge the phase boundary is static during relaxation, after the 4 mA/cm2 charge it keeps moving.

quantities.quantity: time to strip a 0.65 um plated layer (model)
quantities.notes: Model result, not an image measurement.

movie.caption_verbatim: Operando optical visualization of the complete charging-relaxation-discharge cycle in the graphite electrode.
movie.geometry: The paper's caption runs along the top of the frame (to y 80 px) and its own voltage plot sits in the lower right corner (from x 838, y 578 px); the electrode cross-section fills the band between.
movie.on_screen: text overlay of phase and global SoC (e.g. 'Charging 13.1% SoC', 'Relaxing 83% SoC', 'Discharging 40.3% SoC') plus an inset voltage-vs-time plot (0-25 h axis) that is drawn progressively (red = charge, green = relax, blue = discharge)
movie.conditions: 2 mA/cm2 cycle only (inset ends during the first discharge; 4 mA/cm2 is not shown) - derived from the inset
movie.time_base: Stated acquisition 1 min/frame. 1048 distinct frames would cover ~17.5 h, but the inset spans ~0-25 h, so the movie is subsampled or variably timed. Map frames to time from the inset curve end-point or the SoC overlay, not by frame count.
movie.figure_correspondence: Fig. 2 timesteps 1-9 are stills of this sequence (registration to Fig. 2 strips gives 138-1323 inliers)
movie.plating_in_movie: plating onset is stated at ~10 h of charge and visible at the LSE (left edge) by end of charge (ts 4)

other_source_data_sheets: Fig. 4 (pore statistics), Fig. 5 (coin-cell OCV relaxation), Fig. 6-8 (model). None is tied to the movie; not converted.
